factual_errors.text: Higher only: the equations F = m × a and a = (v − u) / t combine to give F = m Δv / Δt.
factual_errors.correction: The specification labels this whole section '4.5.7.3 Changes in momentum (physics only)'. It also labels collision calculations '(physics only complete calculations involving an event, such as the collision of two objects.)' The lesson never says this content is physics only. Instead it applies a 'Higher only' label to just this one paragraph. That suggests the rest of the momentum content is foundation-tier, which is wrong. In the AQA specification the whole of 4.5.7 Momentum is Higher Tier only. So the tier label should cover all of it, and 4.5.7.3 and the collision calculations should also be marked physics only.
factual_errors.basis: spec (physics-only labels); own knowledge (whole of 4.5.7 is HT only)
